New schema (REST opt-in header Api-Revision: 2026-05-20): "response_format": {"type": "image", "mime_type": "image/jpeg", "aspect_ratio": "1:1", "image_size": "1K"}; mime_type is new relative to legacy image_config (allowed values not listed there).
Legacy form: "generation_config": {"image_config": {"aspect_ratio": "1:1", "image_size": "1K"}}; the OpenAPI spec marks GenerationConfig.image_config and ImageConfig as deprecated.

Migration checklist: "(Image Generation) Move image_config from generation_config to a {"type": "image", ...} entry in response_format"; SDK comment: "image_config is removed from generation_config — use response_format".

ImageResponseFormat fields: aspect_ratio, delivery (inline | uri), image_size, mime_type, type (required, always "image"). Example object: {"type": "image", "aspect_ratio": "16:9", "image_size": "1K", "mime_type": "image/jpeg"}.
response_format accepts a ResponseFormat or an array of ResponseFormat; its field description speaks only of a JSON schema.

Model-behaviour settings (thinking, seed) stay in generation_config, so an image request uses two blocks; how to request the image modality explicitly (response_modalities) is not stated — extractor inference.
Gemini 3 guide example: "response_format": {"type": "image", "aspect_ratio": "16:9", "image_size": "4K"} together with "tools": [{"type": "google_search"}].
Image options can be set anew on a follow-up turn (mime_type "image/jpeg", aspect_ratio "16:9", image_size "2K").
Cookbook notebook instead writes generation_config={"image_generation_config": {"aspect_ratio": …, "image_size": …}} — a field name absent from the API references.
